name: Messenger
description:
Modular messaging hub for WhatsApp and Telegram with smart Contacts resolution, Persona-aware multi-bot Telegram selection, photo & document delivery, deterministic WhatsApp Web 2026 stanza verification, and 15-minute follow-up channel continuity.

**Quick Commands:**
- `/msg <platform>:<contact_or_address> <text>`: Direct send bypassing AI (e.g. `/msg whatsapp:Rowena Hello!`).
- `/send`: Alias of `/msg`.

commands.check_connection: Checks live connectivity and readiness of WhatsApp and Telegram.
commands.list_accounts: Lists configured WhatsApp and Telegram accounts and active delivery methods.
commands.send_document: Sends a document or file (PDF, HTML, DOCX, ZIP, audio, video) on Telegram or WhatsApp.
commands.send_message: Sends a text message (and optional attachments) to a contact name or address on WhatsApp or Telegram.
commands.send_photo: Sends a photo or image file ('latest' or [[IMG:filename]]) on Telegram or WhatsApp.

function.name: MESSENGER__send_message
function.description: Sends a text message (and optional attachments) on WhatsApp or Telegram. Automatically resolves contact names from Hecos Contacts! ALWAYS invoke this tool before claiming a message was sent. Once it returns ✅, do NOT call it again with the same message.

to.description: Target recipient: 'group:<GroupName>' for a WhatsApp or Telegram group/channel (e.g. 'group:Hecos'), a Contact name from Address Book (e.g. 'Rowena', or 'admin' when messaging the user privately), 'last' for an immediate follow-up within 15 minutes, or direct address ('whatsapp:+393331234567', 'telegram:@channel', 'telegram:123456789').

text.description: Message body to send (single-line or multi-line), written naturally in first-person staying strictly in character.

platform.description: Target messaging platform: 'whatsapp' (also when user says 'wazzap' / 'whatsapp web') or 'telegram'. Omit on immediate follow-up messages so Messenger reuses the verified recent channel.

bot_name.description: Optional Telegram bot identifier (e.g. 'Urania', 'hecos'). Omit to automatically select the bot matching your active persona.

attachments.description: Optional list of file paths or filenames to attach with the message.

function.name: MESSENGER__send_photo
function.description: Sends a photo or image file to a contact or channel on Telegram or WhatsApp. When sending a newly captured/created selfie or photo: call IMAGE_GEN__generate_image first, then call MESSENGER__send_photo with image_path='latest' (or the [[IMG:filename]]). NEVER use EXECUTOR__write_file to fake .jpg files!

to.description: Contact name (e.g. 'admin' for the user, 'Rowena'), 'last' for follow-ups, or platform address ('telegram:@channel', 'whatsapp:+393331234567').

image_path.description: Pass 'latest' to send the most recently created photo/image, or the bare filename from [[IMG:filename.png]], or an existing image path on disk.

caption.description: Optional caption sent with the photo. Write naturally in first-person staying strictly in character (e.g. 'a photo of me' / 'my selfie'); NEVER mention AI, generation, or tools.

platform.description: Target platform ('telegram' or 'whatsapp'). Omit on immediate follow-ups to reuse the verified recent channel.

bot_name.description: Optional Telegram bot identifier (e.g. 'Urania', 'hecos'). Omit to auto-match your active persona.

function.name: MESSENGER__send_document
function.description: Sends a document or file (PDF, HTML, DOCX, TXT, ZIP, audio, video) to a contact or channel on Telegram or WhatsApp.

to.description: Contact name (e.g. 'admin', 'Rowena'), 'last' for follow-ups, or platform address.

file_path.description: Path or filename of the document/file to send (e.g. PDF path from DOCS__generate_pdf, or 'latest' for the newest generated document).

caption.description: Optional caption accompanying the document, written naturally in character.

bot_name.description: Optional Telegram bot identifier ('Urania', 'hecos'). Omit to auto-match active persona.

function.name: MESSENGER__list_accounts
function.description: Returns configured WhatsApp and Telegram accounts and their active delivery methods.

function.name: MESSENGER__check_connection
function.description: Tests live connectivity for WhatsApp and/or Telegram and reports readiness.

platform.description: Optional platform to check ('whatsapp' or 'telegram'). Omit to check all.

slash_commands.description: Sends a direct message via WhatsApp or Telegram (supports contact names from Address Book).
slash_commands.example: /msg whatsapp:Rowena Hello, this is a test!
